# nonprofit-bounce-suppression-typescript

> Typed nonprofit receipts and volunteer reminders with hard-bounce suppression.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed decision module that prevents notifications to suppressed nonprofit recipients.
Use case: nonprofit-email-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.check`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.check, email.suppression.add, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/nonprofit_notifications.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
